poc_scope: 30-day Dedicated POC: provision 2-node dedicated pool in us-west-2, VPC peering, SSO integration, sample traffic mirror from hosted instance. Canary rollout: route 5% production-like traffic for week1, 25% week2, 100% week4 if SLOs met. Test model variants: baseline (redwood-compat-small quantized), candidate (llama2-13b-8bit), fallback cheap variant for high load. Validate region failover to eu-west-1 with read-only routing and automatic rollback triggers.
canary_strategy: Start at 5% of mirrored traffic; monitor p50/p95, token cost, hallucination rate on eval set. If any of: p95 > 600ms, error rate >1%, or quality regression >5% on prompts -> pause and rollback to hosted or previous model variant. After 7 days of stable metrics, increase to 25% then 50%, final cutover gated by SE sign-off.
fallback_routing_plan: Primary: dedicated us-west-2 cluster. On degraded cluster health (CPU/GPU overload or >1% errors for 5m) failover to compatible model variant in eu-west-1 with auto-traffic-shift. Fallback uses smaller model variant to preserve latency. All traffic during failover served under reduced throughput limits and throttling applied. Post-failover: automated incident ticket creation (Jira) and rollback window 24h.
rollback_triggers: model quality regression vs canary eval >5%
